name: Subverse Splitter
description: Separate a track into drums, bass, vocals and other instruments, pull the vocal off a mix, or read a track's tempo and musical key — all in the browser, nothing to install. Separation uses the HT-Demucs model with overlapping windows, so the stems have no seams at the segment joins. Key and BPM analysis is unlimited for members; separations are one a day.
